command.brntalk.clear_all.success: [BRNTalk] Cleared all dialogue progress for %1$s player(s).
command.brntalk.clear.failure: [BRNTalk] Failed to clear dialogue progress. The targets may have no matching dialogue.
command.brntalk.has_seen.true: [BRNTalk] Player %1$s has read message %2$s in script %3$s.
command.brntalk.has_seen.false: [BRNTalk] Player %1$s has not read message %2$s in script %3$s.
command.brntalk.resume.success: [BRNTalk] Resumed dialogue %2$s for %1$s player(s), restoring %3$s thread(s).
command.brntalk.resume_filtered.success: [BRNTalk] Resumed dialogue %2$s for %1$s player(s), filtered by ID %3$s, restoring %4$s thread(s).
command.brntalk.resume.failure: [BRNTalk] Failed to resume dialogue. The players may not have it or it may not be waiting.
config.option.brntalk.use_vanilla_style_: Use Vanilla Style GUI and Background
If set to true, the custom GUI and background will be replaced by the standard vanilla dark background.
config.option.brntalk.char_delay.tooltip: Lower value means faster typing speed. Set to 0 to display immediately.
config.option.brntalk.msg_pause.tooltip: Pause Time between continuous messages. Set to 0 to disable pausing.
config.option.brntalk.smooth_factor.tool: Smooth factor of scrolling. Lower value means smoother scrolling.
config.option.brntalk.displayOpenButton: Whether to display the 'Open Screen' button or not
If true, the button will be displayed on every container screens. This won't work if you have installed FTB Library.
config.option.brntalk.openButtonX: X position of the 'Open Screen' button (pixel)
config.option.brntalk.openButtonX.toolti: The distance between button and the left edge of screen. This won't work if you have installed FTB Library.
config.option.brntalk.openButtonY: Y position of the 'Open Screen' button (pixel)
config.option.brntalk.openButtonY.toolti: The distance between button and the top edge of screen. This won't work if you have installed FTB Library.
config.option.brntalk.notificationMode.t: How new messages are displayed. Other HUD settings are only available when this is set to 'HUD'.
config.option.brntalk.hudScale.tooltip: The total size multiplier of HUD. 1.0 means original size.
config.option.brntalk.hudOffsetY.tooltip: Relative to the center. Positive value moves HUD down, negative moves up.
config.option.brntalk.hudTopMargin.toolt: Messages won't be rendered if they go above this Y position to prevent overlapping.
